name: qol-workflow
description: Cross-cutting workflow conventions for any qol-tools repo: commit message conventions (with the no-attribution hard rule), git push and worktree workflows, and universal coding guidelines. Ships PreToolUse hooks that (1) inject commit context, (2) block AI-attribution lines, (3) block branch-creation/switching inside a qol-* main clone (worktrees-only rule), (4) deny per-tool `match` branches added to shared CLI-sessions code (the naming/backends law), (5) refuse pull request titles the repository commit-msg gate would refuse.
